nextExecutableAction: Lead reads/accepts this artifact and records the wave0 commit plus accepted shared registry/ACL/envelope/outbox/action-layout contracts. Re-read/re-hash the specific shared sources at that committed revision and resolve file ownership; then implement the three normative new paths and root-approved patches, starting the capability-disabled landing without falsely adding child DAG prerequisites. risks: The explicit empty dependency array does not prove shared primitives are ready. Hidden foundation contracts must not become silent N/A requirements or invented RS-* dependency edges.
Root-owned uncommitted wave0 work may invalidate hashes/line references during integration; report is a snapshot of inspected working-tree bytes, not feature evidence for an unobserved later commit.
Shared ModeScreenLayout changes can regress Tasks and other mode screens. Keep opt-in responsive Meetings behavior and exercise Sessions/Tasks after integration.
Local live bucket means recording/paused, not an online room. Provider remains null/undecided; SFU success cannot be inferred from an action tile, draft or token.
Workspace filtering is not shared ACL. Current null-workspace inclusion, changed-row refresh and transcript prefetch require authoritative access decisions before catalog federation.
Renderer reload recovers/finalizes partial audio; it does not keep a JS MediaRecorder alive. Another live renderer's owner must remain protected; do not auto-start replacement capture.

importAudio rejects metadata/size errors but supported-extension corrupt bytes may become audio-ready with duration0 after failed probe. Invalid-media acceptance needs actual decode validation and material states, not extension-only tests.
Current import handler lacks rejection handling; disk/copy/IPC errors must remain visible without producing fake success or hiding existing rows.
Current handlePlan creates local planned metadata. Relabeling it as Calendar planning would violate provider-event semantics and RS-MTG-03 handoff.
No loaded-font, UI, runtime, ACL mutation, build or test success is claimed; these remain explicitly unverified as required by the preflight boundary.

Shared registry/gateway/search/outbox owners and concrete paths are not directly imported by inspected local seams. Their implementation must come from accepted wave0 receipts rather than guessed new files or a second architecture.
